text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in mild retreat over the last day, with Ethereum's 2.7% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 1.8%, signaling slightly elevated caution among large-cap holders even as the Fear & Greed index sits firmly in greed territory. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59% despite the pullback suggests the market structure remains intact, though the $82B in daily volume is moderate—neither a panic sell-off nor euphoric accumulation. The mixed performance across altcoins (BNB outperforming while SOL softens) indicates rotation rather than broad contagion, consistent with a consolidation phase after recent gains.
